description: Heavy tar opioid, cut with whatever was nearby. The deepest nod there is.

effects.onset_message: It hits all at once. You're warm all over, and nothing matters.

overdose.message: You nod off, and your breathing stops.

phases.end_message: You come round gasping, and you feel worse than before.
phases.peak_message: You go under. Everything goes black and peaceful.

effects.take_line: You cook {name} down and get it into you.

withdrawal.message: Withdrawal has you. You'd give almost anything to make it stop.

stages.easing: The sweating stops before the shaking does. For an hour it feels like it's over. It isn't.
stages.onset: Your nose starts running and won't stop. It's a while before you realise it's the first sign.
stages.peak: You can feel your stomach working, every churn of it. Your legs ache and you can't keep them still.
stages.rising: You sneeze eleven times in a row, then again a few minutes later. Your eyes keep watering.
stages.tail: You're back on your feet, but your legs still won't let you sit down for long.

name: blacktar
